{{recipe}}

This recipe is not for those of you that will call the fire department if you taste a chile.

== Ingredients ==
* 40 [[Cookbook:Okra|okra]], stemmed and halved lengthwise
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] salt
* 2 tbsp freshly ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]], divided
* [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|Hot sauce]]
* 2½ [[Cookbook:Quart|quarts]] [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|peanut oil]]
* Kosher salt

==Procedure==
#Combine salt, peppers, and ½ cup flour. Coat okra with flour mixture.
#Dip okra into hot sauce and [[Cookbook:Dredging|dredge]] in remaining flour, adding more as needed. Let rest 2–3 minutes.
#Heat oil in a large pot or a deep-fryer to 375°F. Add okra, 6 at a time, and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] 3–4 minutes until golden brown and crispy. Drain on a [[Cookbook:Cooling Rack|cooling rack]] and repeat until all okra has been fried.
#Sprinkle fried okra with additional kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper and serve warm.

Heat oil in a large pot or a deep-fryer to 375°F. Add okra, 6 at a time, and fry 3–4 minutes until golden brown and crispy. Drain on a cooling rack and repeat until all okra has been fried.
